title: Sense, Sensibility & Snowmen
description: Christmas party planners Ella and her sister Marianne clash with client Edward, a not-so-jolly toy company CEO.

title: A Wish for Christmas
description: Sara prefers to be on the sidelines at work until someone steals her big idea for a Christmas initiative. She makes a wish to Santa to gain the courage to stand up for herself, and he gives her 48 hours to discover how to speak her own mind.

title: A Very Merry Mix-Up
description: A woman plans to meet her future in-laws at Christmas and, through a serendipitous series of events, spends the holiday with a warm and caring family whose son catches her eye.

title: Crown for Christmas
description: After getting fired from her job as a maid at a ritzy New York City hotel, a woman accepts a temporary job as governess to a young girl who is part of a powerful European family.

title: A Royal Christmas
description: The queen of Cordinia schemes to break up her royal son's romance with a seamstress from Philadelphia.

title: Double Booked for the Holidays
description: Twins Abigail and Charlie spend Christmas in Wales to run a bookstore and get swept into holiday romances with two Hay-on-Wye locals, a charming barista and a dashing lord.

title: Return to Santa
description: When Santa finds Jake's decades-old Christmas list, he decides to fast-track all the wishes, disrupting Jake's practical life and jeopardizing his reconnection with childhood best friend Julie.

title: The Most Wonderful Secret
description: An art teacher visiting family for Christmas starts receiving gifts from "Your Secret Norma." With the late Norma's son, she follows a scavenger hunt and finds love and purpose along the way.

title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
description: After a bad blind date, Lindsey and Philip both end up at Walt Disney World Resort, where a Christmas wish takes them from never ever to ever after.

title: Santa Tell Me
description: A design show host finds a letter from Santa promising to meet her true love, a man named Nick, by Christmas Eve. Meeting three Nicks complicates her search.

title: Single on the 25th
description: For Nell Duke, nothing is worse than being single during Christmastime as everywhere she looks, couples are kissing under the mistletoe. However, she soon makes a special connection with a neighbor who shows her how to keep the holidays festive.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Christmas
description: Single dad Taylor is inspired more than ever to give his two children the best Christmas in their new town. He leads the city's holiday event department, as new colleague Sophie supervises him.

title: Small Town Christmas
description: Nell's last stop on a nationwide book tour takes her to Springdale, the hometown of Emmett, a young man she met while both were junior copy editors at a New York publishing company.

title: A Danish Christmas
description: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge, and the two find a connection as well.

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
description: Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.

title: Christmas Under the Lights
description: Emily reluctantly returns home to her family's rescue ranch to organize the Christmas Carnival and works with a handsome artist to honor her mother.

title: Adopting St. Nick
description: After adopting a grandparent from a new retirement community for the holidays, Maren and her daughter Leah cross paths with the program's manager, Reid, and the suspiciously jolliest of residents.

title: The Christmas Eve Feast
description: Silvy heads home to Boston for Christmas to prepare the Feast of the Seven Fishes while her nonna recovers from an injury and is charmed by Ethan, a local photographer documenting the meal.

title: Following Yonder Star
description: A former television star waits out a scandal in Vermont. She becomes close with the innkeeper and his daughter while she helps him direct the local Christmas pageant.

title: Eight Nights for Love
description: This Hanukkah, a magical menorah shows Hannah that love has always been right in front of her in the form of her childhood best friend Ethan -- if only she's willing to take the risk.

title: Miles to Christmas
description: When a snowstorm wrecks their travel plans from Chicago to Tennessee, Cassidy and Jo must hitch a ride from Chase, Jo's trucker brother, to get home in time for Christmas morning.
